observations.reduced_probe_result: Both the 32-prefill plus 32-decode checkpoint sequence and the full-resident varied-prefill-chain version passed all exposed checkpoints.

failures.summary: Four independent canonical runs each lost exactly one batch-1 hidden element in decode phase 1; the failing layer and coordinate moved, while every coordinate was lane 31 modulo 32 and all seven cache outputs remained exact.

observations.runtime_error: Vortex kernel wait failed with error -1; the device is poisoned and the process must be restarted

failures.summary: The free-running S4 process exceeded the 300-second kernel wait in prefill layer 0 and exited with device-poisoned status without an in-process retry.
